prompt.content:
You are generating synthetic enterprise support ticket text for a dataset used to train and evaluate support-case classification systems. For each case in the input JSON array, write a realistic support ticket TITLE and DESCRIPTION as the customer would write it — not as an engineer would describe the internal diagnosis.

Vary sentence structure, technical sophistication, length, clarity, and tone across cases. Some customers are precise; some are rambling, use shorthand, misspell things, or bury the important detail in the third sentence. Never state the internal root cause, resolution type, issue subcategory, or team name verbatim — those are back-office labels the customer has never seen. Only reference the symptoms, environment, impact, and (if given) the customer's own theory/misdiagnosis.

Follow the "narrative_instruction" field for each case exactly.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"cases": [{"i": <int>, "title": "...", "description": "..."}, ...]} covering every case index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 45, 'product_customer_sees': 'Payment Gateway v2', 'environment': 'production', 'region': 'EU-West', 'symptoms_observed': ['overcharge', 'chargeback notice received'], 'reported_business_impact': 'high', 'reported_affected_users': 794, 'narrative_instruction': 'The customer believes the problem is in the product/component they are looking at, with no idea that the real cause may be an upstream/third-party dependency. Do not have the customer mention a vendor or dependency at all.'}, {'i': 46, 'product_customer_sees': 'Token Service', 'environment': 'production', 'region': 'ME', 'symptoms_observed': ['sync stuck'], 'reported_business_impact': 'high', 'reported_affected_users': 590, 'narrative_instruction': 'Write a clear, reasonably well-organized ticket. The customer describes what they observed accurately and with enough detail to act on.'}, {'i': 47, 'product_customer_sees': 'Report Builder', 'environment': 'production', 'region': 'EU-West', 'symptoms_observed': ['full outage reported', 'service unresponsive'], 'reported_business_impact': 'high', 'reported_affected_users': 355, 'narrative_instruction': "The customer names the product given as 'product the customer believes is affected' (which may differ from the actual affected product) — write the ticket as if that's the product they think is broken."}, {'i': 48, 'product_customer_sees': 'Analytics Dashboard', 'environment': 'staging', 'region': 'APAC', 'symptoms_observed': ['timeout', 'high latency'], 'reported_business_impact': 'moderate', 'reported_affected_users': 11, 'narrative_instruction': 'Write a clear, reasonably well-organized ticket. The customer describes what they observed accurately and with enough detail to act on.'}, {'i': 49, 'product_customer_sees': 'Analytics Dashboard', 'environment': 'production', 'region': 'ANZ', 'symptoms_observed': ['audit log gap detected', 'retention policy not applied'], 'reported_business_impact': 'high', 'reported_affected_users': 282, 'narrative_instruction': 'Write a clear, reasonably well-organized ticket.
